summary: Twelve games were played. Stephen Curry scored 44 for Golden State in a 119-114 win at Minnesota, and Victor Wembanyama scored 36 in San Antonio's 117-111 overtime win at Utah. Houston beat Milwaukee 132-100 and Toronto beat Orlando 129-99, and both winners led by more than 30 points.

games.headline: Pistons take over in the third and beat Hornets 97-89
games.story: Charlotte led 51-44 at halftime, and Brandon Miller scored 31 points with 12 rebounds. Detroit outscored the Hornets 32-19 in the third quarter to lead 76-70 after three. The Pistons trailed 56-54 with 7:55 left in the third and led the rest of the way. Cade Cunningham scored 30 points with seven assists, and Charlotte had 23 turnovers to Detroit's 13.

games.headline: Heat build an 18-point lead and beat Hawks 129-117
games.story: Miami led 34-25 after the first quarter and 69-56 at halftime, and its lead reached 18 points. The Heat trailed only early in the first quarter. Giannis Antetokounmpo had 24 points and 18 rebounds in 31 minutes, and Bam Adebayo also scored 24. Atlanta's Kingston Flemings scored 23 on 9-of-12 shooting and Nickeil Alexander-Walker added 23.

games.headline: Sixers erase a 13-point deficit and beat Pacers 114-109
games.story: Indiana led 88-75 after three quarters, then Philadelphia outscored the Pacers 39-21 in the fourth. The game was tied at 94-94 with 5:38 left, and the Sixers led the rest of the way. Tyrese Maxey scored 27 points and Joel Embiid had 21 points and 11 rebounds. Pascal Siakam scored 26 with 11 rebounds for Indiana.

games.headline: Cavaliers outscore Wizards 29-19 in the fourth, win 121-111
games.story: Washington led 42-34 after the first quarter and 69-59 at halftime, with a lead as large as 13. Cleveland outscored the Wizards 33-23 in the third quarter to tie the game at 92-92. The Cavaliers did not trail again after Washington went up 105-104 with 6:16 left. Evan Mobley scored 24 points with 12 rebounds and five three-pointers, and Peyton Watson added 22.

games.headline: Raptors lead by as many as 33 and rout Magic 129-99
games.story: Toronto led 69-53 at halftime and 103-76 after three quarters, with its lead peaking at 33 points. Scottie Barnes scored 28 on 11-of-17 shooting, and RJ Barrett had 25 points, nine rebounds and six assists. Orlando committed 20 turnovers to Toronto's 14 and made 10 of 35 three-pointers. Orlando was without Paolo Banchero, Jalen Suggs and Jonathan Isaac.

games.headline: Nuggets lead from start to finish, beat Pelicans 104-91
games.story: Denver scored first and never trailed or was tied, taking a 37-18 lead after the first quarter and building it to 22 points. New Orleans outscored the Nuggets 28-22 in the third quarter to cut it to 79-73. Nikola Jokic had 21 points, 13 rebounds and 10 assists, and Jamal Murray scored 23. Zion Williamson led New Orleans with 25 points.

games.headline: Curry scores 44, Warriors hold off Timberwolves 119-114
games.story: Golden State led 64-48 at halftime and by as many as 24 points. Minnesota outscored the Warriors 66-55 in the second half but did not lead after the first quarter. Stephen Curry scored 44 points on 11-of-27 shooting, with six three-pointers and 16 of 16 from the free-throw line. Yaxel Lendeborg added 26 points for Golden State, and Jonathan Kuminga scored 20 for Minnesota.

games.headline: Rockets lead by 35 and beat Bucks 132-100
games.story: Houston outscored Milwaukee 34-14 in the second quarter to lead 57-35 at halftime, and the lead peaked at 35 points. Fred VanVleet scored 24 points, Amen Thompson had 23 and Kevin Durant added 18. The Rockets made 17 of 38 three-pointers while the Bucks made 12 of 41. Tyler Herro led Milwaukee with 23 points.

games.headline: Knicks outscore Bulls 43-31 in the fourth, win 133-127
games.story: Chicago led 62-56 at halftime and 96-90 after three quarters, and its lead peaked at 19 points. New York outscored the Bulls 43-31 in the fourth quarter, and the lead changed hands 18 times in the game. The score was tied 109-109 with 6:51 left, and the Knicks did not trail again. Jalen Brunson scored 38 points with six three-pointers, and Norman Powell scored 30 for Chicago.

games.headline: Wembanyama scores 36, Spurs beat Jazz 117-111 in OT
games.story: Utah led 32-22 after the first quarter, and the teams were tied at 105-105 after regulation. In overtime Utah led 108-107 before the score was tied at 108-108 with 2:24 left. San Antonio outscored the Jazz 12-6 in the extra period. Victor Wembanyama scored 36 points with 14 rebounds, five assists, three steals and two blocks, and Keyonte George scored 31 for Utah.

games.headline: Mavericks hold Thunder to 5-of-32 on threes, win 120-96
games.story: Dallas led 65-59 at halftime and 94-81 after three quarters, then outscored Oklahoma City 26-15 in the fourth. The Mavericks' lead peaked at 27 points. Cooper Flagg scored 26 points with eight assists, and Ajay Mitchell led the Thunder with 29. Oklahoma City made 5 of 32 three-pointers, while Dallas made 16 of 45.

games.headline: Lakers outscore Clippers 31-16 in second quarter, win 103-87
games.story: Los Angeles led 56-38 at halftime and by as many as 23 points. Quentin Grimes scored 23 points with four steals, and Collin Sexton scored 21 in 21 minutes. Keaton Wagler scored 21 for the Clippers, going 10 of 12 at the free-throw line and 4 of 15 from the field. The Clippers committed 24 turnovers to the Lakers' 19.
